subject: Interview loop: Senior Infrastructure Engineer - scheduling

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: Full interview loop with Redwood Inference

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time to speak with us for the Senior Infrastructure Engineer role. We'd like to schedule a full interview loop (virtual) that will be ~3 x 45-min interviews + a 30-min leadership conversation (total ~3.5 hours including short breaks).

Can you share 2–3 windows (in your local timezone) over the next two weeks when you can do a longer block (ideally 3–4 hours contiguous)? Timezone?

Tentative panel sequencing we usually run:
- Systems design / architecture (45m)
- Deep technical (kernel/infra) (45m)
- Cross-functional / product-led infra (45m)
- Hiring manager / leadership (30m)

Please also confirm if you prefer a single longer day or two half-days.

I've attached your resume we have on file for quick reference.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
(Attachment: alex_ramos_resume.pdf)

Subject: Proposed slots + agenda for interview loop

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the quick reply and helpful windows. Based on interviewer availability we can offer two options (all EDT):

Option A — Single day (preferred):
- 13:30–14:15: Systems design / architecture (Vivek Kulkarni)
- 14:30–15:15: Deep technical (Markus Klein)
- 15:30–16:15: Cross-functional / product infra (Stephanie Nguyen)
- 16:30–17:00: Hiring manager / leadership (Monica Patel)

Option B — Split across two half-days:
Day 1 (Wed Apr 21) 09:30–11:00: Systems design + Deep technical (shorter, back-to-back)
Day 2 (Fri Apr 23) 14:00–15:30: Cross-functional + Hiring manager

If Option A works, I will send a calendar invite and an onsite agenda doc (prep notes + interviewer names/links). Please confirm preferred option and we will finalize.

Prep notes: interviewers will expect a short whiteboard for systems design, a couple deep debugging/analysis problems, and a 10–15 minute discussion on cross-functional tradeoffs.

(Attachments to follow: onsite_agenda.pdf, redwood_interviewer_prep.docx)

Thanks —
Monica
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Proposed slots + agenda for interview loop

Quick internal sync —

Option A looks good but I'd like to flip order of the second and third interviews so candidate gets the deeper systems discussion earlier. Proposed sequencing (Option A-1):
- 13:30–14:15: Systems design / architecture (Vivek)
- 14:30–15:15: Cross-functional / product infra (Stephanie)
- 15:30–16:15: Deep technical (Markus)
- 16:30–17:00: Hiring manager / leadership (Monica)

Reason: Markus prefers having the deep technical after the candidate has warmed up with system-level context; keeps focus for the product/communication questions in the middle. Also would like 10-minute buffer after each session for quick interviewer notes — please ensure calendar invites are 50/40-min blocks with 10-minute gaps.

Vivek, Markus — ok on your side?

Thanks —
Stephanie
